description: What one point of an instrument is worth, and its smallest tradable size.

currency.description: The currency the point value is in. Never converted.

point_value.description:
What one point of price is worth per unit held, as a decimal string.
Given with either of the other two missing, the declaration is
cleared instead — which returns the instrument to "nothing here knows
what a point is worth", the same contract `set_ruler_step` uses.

size_step.description: The smallest tradable increment of quantity.

symbol.description: The symbol to declare for. Left out, the chart's own.

title: SetInstrumentMoneyInput
